item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera plants a bean seed in a pot at her home in Pune. She turns the pot upside down so that the germinating seedling is inverted, and keeps it near a window where sunlight comes from the right side. After a few days, what will she observe about the direction of growth of the root and the shoot?

options.A: The root keeps growing upward and the shoot keeps growing downward, in the directions they were already pointing.
options.B: The root grows downward and the shoot grows upward, bending towards the sunlight.
options.C: The root bends towards the sunlight and the shoot grows downward.
options.D: Both the root and the shoot bend towards the sunlight coming from the right.
